title: Web Crawler Multithreaded
summary: Crawl from startUrl using an HtmlParser that returns the links of a page, following only links whose host equals the start URL's host; return every reachable same-host URL once, with concurrent fetching and visited tracking.
inputFormat: startUrl and an htmlParser with a getUrls(url) method.
outputFormat: A list of reachable same-host URLs; order not recorded.
tieRules: Each URL appears once in the result.
edgeRules: Host comparison rule (scheme, port, normalisation) is not recorded.
